title: 第17章 冰冰怀疑第18章 冰冰拒绝
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
陈阳眉头紧锁，语气带着几分怒意，“菲姐，这种事你怎么不跟我说？早知道我陪你一起去，看我不帮你好好收拾她！”
刘傲菲轻轻摇了摇头，眼神黯淡下来：“这本来就是我的私事，不想麻烦你……只是现在我这脸毁了，冰冰还没看见呢。”
她的声音里泛起一丝哽咽，“我真不知道她明天早上看见我这个样子，会有多伤心。”
陈阳心中一动。
他刚开启的治疗神功正好能派上用场。
绝对能让她的脸恢复如初。
陈阳安慰道：“菲姐，你也别太担心，你脸皮薄，要是伤得不重，睡一觉估计就好了。”
“哪有那么容易好？”刘傲菲苦笑一声，语气满是绝望，“给我上药的医生都说了，我这伤口有点深，就算好了，也肯定会留下疤痕的。”
她伸出微微颤抖的手，紧紧抓住陈阳的手，眼神里充满了不安和期盼，像个无助的孩子：“阳阳，我脸上要是留下难看的疤痕，你会嫌弃我吗？”
“不会。”陈阳想都没想就摇了摇头。
“真的吗？你不骗我？”刘傲菲追问，眼中满是不确定。
陈阳看着她泛红的眼眶，心中一软，伸手轻轻揽过她的肩膀，低头在她唇上印下一个吻。
他语气坚定：“我说过，我就好你这一口。”
刘傲菲被他突如其来的吻吻得浑身一颤，脸颊瞬间染上红晕。
她看着陈阳深邃的眼眸，轻声说：“那你今晚别走，留下来陪我，好不好？”
陈阳心中微微一怔，有些犹豫。
毕竟刘冰冰还在家里，要是被她发现，后果不堪设想。
可看着刘傲菲满是期盼和脆弱的眼神，他实在不忍心拒绝：“行，就依你。”
说完，他再次低头，想要吻上她的唇。
刘傲菲却轻轻抽开脸，笑着说：“等一下，我先去戴个面罩。”

她起身走到衣橱旁，打开柜门，从里面翻出一个黑色的蕾丝面罩。
面罩做工精致，边缘绣着细密的花纹，戴上后刚好遮住她脸颊上的纱布和伤口。
只露出一双水汪汪的大眼睛和线条优美的嘴唇，看起来既神秘又性感。
陈阳看着她走近，伸手抓住她的双手，好奇问：“菲姐，这面罩哪里来的？挺特别的。”
“一个朋友外出旅游时，特意给我带回来的纪念品。”刘傲菲笑着说：“我一直没找到机会戴，现在刚好派上用场。”
她说着，拿起放在床头的手机，点开了一首舒缓浪漫的钢琴曲。
轻柔的旋律在房间里流淌开来，与暖黄的小夜灯相得益彰，瞬间营造出温馨又暧昧的氛围。
陈阳感受着周围的气氛，忍不住笑了笑：“菲姐，你还真有情调。”
刘傲菲轻轻靠在他的肩膀上，语气带着几分感慨：“那倒也是，要不是遇到你，我都快忘了自己年轻时有多浪漫了。”
“这些年为了冰冰操心，为了公司的事操心，倒是忘了为我自己着想。”
“那就从现在起，为自己而活。”陈阳将她紧紧搂在怀里。
“嗯。”刘傲菲应了声，眼中带着浓浓的情意，主动凑上前来，吻住了陈阳的唇。
两人在浪漫的旋律中深情拥吻。
content_en:
Chen Yang frowned and said with a hint of anger, "Sister Fei, why didn't you tell me this kind of thing? If you had known I would have gone with you, why wouldn't I have helped you take care of her!"
Liu Aofei shook her head gently, her eyes darkening: "This is my private matter originally, and I don't want to trouble you... It's just that now my face is ruined, and Bingbing hasn't seen it yet."
There was a hint of choking in her voice, "I really don't know how sad she will be when she sees me like this tomorrow morning."
Chen Yang's heart moved.
The healing power he had just activated came in handy.
It will definitely restore her face to its original appearance.
Chen Yang comforted him: "Sister Fei, don't worry too much. You are thin-skinned. If the injury is not serious, you will probably be fine if you sleep."
"How can it be so easy?" Liu Aofei smiled bitterly, her tone full of despair, "The doctor who gave me the medicine said that my wound is a bit deep. Even if it heals, it will definitely leave scars."
She stretched out her slightly trembling hand and grasped Chen Yang's hand tightly. Her eyes were full of uneasiness and expectation, like a helpless child: "Yangyang, if I leave ugly scars on my face, will you dislike me?"
"No." Chen Yang shook his head without thinking.
"Really? You're not lying to me?" Liu Aofei asked, her eyes full of uncertainty.
Chen Yang looked at her red eyes, his heart softened, he reached out and gently put his arm around her shoulders, lowered his head and pressed a kiss on her lips.
His tone was firm: "I said, I just like you."
Liu Aofei trembled from his sudden kiss, and her cheeks instantly turned red.
She looked into Chen Yang's deep eyes and said softly: "Then don't leave tonight and stay with me, okay?"
Chen Yang was slightly startled and hesitant.
After all, Liu Bingbing was still at home. If she were to find out, the consequences would be disastrous.
But looking at Liu Aofei's eyes full of expectation and vulnerability, he really couldn't bear to refuse: "Okay, it's up to you."
After saying that, he lowered his head again and wanted to kiss her lips.
But Liu Aofei gently pulled away her face and said with a smile: "Wait a minute, I'll put on a mask first."
She stood up and walked to the closet, opened the door and pulled out a black lace mask.
The mask was exquisitely made, with fine embroidered patterns on the edges. When worn, it just covered the gauze and wounds on her cheeks.
Only a pair of big watery eyes and graceful lips are exposed, looking mysterious and sexy.
Chen Yang watched her approach, reached out to grab her hands, and asked curiously: "Sister Fei, where did this mask come from? It's quite special."
"A friend brought me a souvenir when he went on a trip." Liu Aofei said with a smile, "I never found a chance to wear it, but now it just comes in handy."
As she spoke, she picked up the mobile phone placed by the bedside and clicked on a soothing and romantic piano music.
The soft melody flows in the room, complementing the warm yellow night light, instantly creating a warm and ambiguous atmosphere.
Chen Yang felt the atmosphere around him and couldn't help but smile: "Sister Fei, you are really sentimental."
Liu Aofei leaned lightly on his shoulder and said with some emotion in her tone: "That's true. If I hadn't met you, I would have almost forgotten how romantic I was when I was young."
"In these years, I have been worrying about Bingbing and the company, but I have forgotten to think about myself."
"Then live for yourself from now on." Chen Yang held her tightly in his arms.
"Yes." Liu Aofei responded, with deep affection in his eyes, and took the initiative to come forward and kiss Chen Yang's lips.
The two kissed passionately to the romantic melody.
